cues: Rigid numbered template with fixed sections: Classification and constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, First end-to-end slice (Phase 0), Phases, Validation checks, Cross-cutting concerns, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Labels every budget value as ASSUMPTION or UNKNOWN with an owner and a phase that checks it, and gives reversibility ratings (R2/R3) to decisions
